```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE, fig.align = "center")
is_lrt_mh <- identical(params$multihit_out$mode, "lrt_module") ||
  isTRUE(params$run_args$analysis_mode == "lrt")
has_lrt_mh <- is_lrt_mh && !is.null(params$multihit_out$by_module) &&
  length(params$multihit_out$by_module) > 0
has_wald_mh <- !is_lrt_mh && !is.null(params$multihit_out$by_comparison) &&
  length(params$multihit_out$by_comparison) > 0
```

## Cross-analysis gene hits

```{r multihit-intro, results='asis'}
mh <- params$multihit_out
if (has_lrt_mh) {
  layers <- paste(mh$layers_used, collapse = ", ")
  cat("\n\nTop **", mh$top_n, "** genes per **degPatterns cluster**, ranked by ",
      "co-occurrence across ", layers,
      " (LRT DEG = cluster membership; WGCNA = any co-expression module; ",
      "VIPER / decoupleR-TF = significant TF; decoupleR-CCC = gene in a ",
      "significant ligand–receptor pair; alpha = ", mh$alpha, "). ",
      "Tables only (no directional barplots in LRT mode).\n\n", sep = "")
  deseq2reports::emit_code_block(
    caption = "Reproduce LRT multi-hit ranking with this package module:",
    "multihit_out <- run_multihit_lrt_pipeline(",
    "  degpatterns_out, diffexp_out,",
    "  wgcna_out = wgcna_out,",
    "  viper_out = viper_out, decoupler_tf_out = decoupler_tf_out,",
    "  decoupler_ccc_out = decoupler_ccc_out",
    ")"
  )
} else if (has_wald_mh) {
  layers <- paste(mh$layers_used, collapse = ", ")
  cat("\n\nTop ", mh$top_n, " **up** and top ", mh$top_n,
      " **down** genes per contrast (direction from DEG log2FoldChange), ",
      "ranked by hit count across ", layers,
      " (GSEA contributes +1 if the gene is in **any** significant ",
      "pathway leading edge; DEG / VIPER / decoupleR-TF / decoupleR-CCC / CSPA contribute +1 ",
      "when selected or significant at alpha = ", mh$alpha, ").\n\n", sep = "")
  deseq2reports::emit_code_block(
    caption = "Reproduce multi-hit ranking with this package module:",
    "multihit_out <- run_multihit_pipeline(",
    "  diffexp_out, gsea_out = gsea_out,",
    "  viper_out = viper_out, decoupler_tf_out = decoupler_tf_out,",
    "  decoupler_ccc_out = decoupler_ccc_out, cspa_out = cspa_out",
    ")"
  )
} else {
  cat("\n\nMulti-hit gene ranking was not available for this run.\n\n")
}
```

```{r multihit-lrt-tables, results='asis', eval=has_lrt_mh}
by_mod <- params$multihit_out$by_module
mods <- names(by_mod)
short_labs <- sub("^.* cluster ", "cluster ", mods)
if (anyDuplicated(short_labs) || any(!nzchar(short_labs))) {
  short_labs <- mods
}
pane_ids <- deseq2reports::bs_tabset_start("multihit-lrt-tabs", short_labs)
for (i in seq_along(mods)) {
  mod <- mods[i]
  deseq2reports::bs_tab_pane_start(pane_ids[i], active = (i == 1L))
  ranked <- by_mod[[mod]]
  if (is.null(ranked) || !nrow(ranked)) {
    cat("\n\nNo genes scored for this cluster.\n\n")
  } else {
    show <- ranked
    for (col in intersect(c("deg", "wgcna", "viper", "decoupler-tf", "decoupler-ccc"), colnames(show))) {
      show[[col]] <- as.integer(show[[col]])
    }
    print(knitr::kable(show, row.names = FALSE))
    safe <- gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9]+", "_", mod)
    deseq2reports::emit_widget(
      deseq2reports::link_output_file(
        file.path(safe, paste0(safe, "_top_genes.csv")),
        label = "Download top genes CSV"
      )
    )
  }
  deseq2reports::bs_tab_pane_end()
}
deseq2reports::bs_tabset_end()
```

```{r multihit-helpers, include=FALSE}
emit_multihit_contrast <- function(comp, ranked, plot) {
  stem <- deseq2reports::contrast_file_stem(comp)
  if (is.null(ranked) || !nrow(ranked)) {
    cat("\n\nNo genes scored for this contrast.\n\n")
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }
  if (!is.null(plot)) {
    sz <- attr(plot, "plot_size")
    w <- if (!is.null(sz)) sz$width else 4.9
    h <- if (!is.null(sz)) sz$height else max(2.8, 0.2 * nrow(ranked) + 1.5)
    deseq2reports::emit_plot_with_download(
      plot, filename = paste0(stem, "_multihit_barplot"),
      width = w, height = h, dpi = 150
    )
  }
  deseq2reports::emit_widget(
    deseq2reports::link_output_file(
      file.path(comp, paste0(stem, "_top_genes.csv")),
      label = "Download top genes CSV"
    )
  )
  cat("\n\n")
}

specs_mh <- params$diffexp_out$contrast_specs
if (is.null(specs_mh) && has_wald_mh) {
  labs <- names(params$multihit_out$by_comparison)
  specs_mh <- data.frame(
    label = labs, class = "single",
    type = deseq2reports::classify_comparison_type(labs),
    stratum_level = NA_character_,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}
two_factor_mh <- !is.null(specs_mh) &&
  any(specs_mh$class %in% c("within_A", "within_B", "within_C", "interaction"))
by_mh <- if (has_wald_mh) params$multihit_out$by_comparison else list()
plots_mh <- if (has_wald_mh) params$multihit_out$plots else list()
```

```{r multihit-single, results='asis', eval=has_wald_mh && !two_factor_mh}
de_pairwise <- specs_mh$label[specs_mh$type == "pairwise"]
de_one_vs_all <- specs_mh$label[specs_mh$type == "one_vs_all"]

cat("\n\n### Pairwise {.tabset}\n\n")
if (length(de_pairwise) > 0) {
  for (comp in de_pairwise) {
    cat("\n\n#### ", comp, "\n\n", sep = "")
    emit_multihit_contrast(comp, by_mh[[comp]], plots_mh[[comp]])
  }
} else {
  cat("\n\nNo pairwise comparisons.\n\n")
}

cat("\n\n### One vs. all {.tabset}\n\n")
if (length(de_one_vs_all) > 0) {
  for (comp in de_one_vs_all) {
    cat("\n\n#### ", comp, "\n\n", sep = "")
    emit_multihit_contrast(comp, by_mh[[comp]], plots_mh[[comp]])
  }
} else {
  cat("\n\nNo one-vs-all comparisons.\n\n")
}
```

```{r multihit-two-factor, results='asis', eval=has_wald_mh && two_factor_mh}
var <- params$var
for (cls in c("main", "within_A", "within_B", "within_C", "interaction")) {
  sub <- specs_mh[specs_mh$class == cls, , drop = FALSE]
  if (nrow(sub) == 0) next
  title <- deseq2reports::contrast_class_title(cls, var)
  cat("\n\n### ", title, " {.tabset}\n\n", sep = "")

  if (identical(cls, "main")) {
    ordered <- c(sub$label[sub$type == "pairwise"],
                 sub$label[sub$type == "one_vs_all"])
    for (comp in ordered) {
      cat("\n\n#### ", comp, "\n\n", sep = "")
      emit_multihit_contrast(comp, by_mh[[comp]], plots_mh[[comp]])
    }
    next
  }

  if (identical(cls, "interaction")) {
    # Interaction rows are grouped by the factor level they hold fixed;
    # three-way rows hold nothing fixed and sit at the top level.
    held <- deseq2reports::contrast_stratum_labels(sub)
    for (comp in sub$label[is.na(held)]) {
      cat("\n\n#### ", comp, "\n\n", sep = "")
      emit_multihit_contrast(comp, by_mh[[comp]], plots_mh[[comp]])
    }
    for (st in unique(held[!is.na(held)])) {
      cat("\n\n#### Within ", st, " {.tabset}\n\n", sep = "")
      for (comp in sub$label[!is.na(held) & held == st]) {
        cat("\n\n##### ", comp, "\n\n", sep = "")
        emit_multihit_contrast(comp, by_mh[[comp]], plots_mh[[comp]])
      }
    }
    next
  }

  strata <- unique(sub$stratum_level)
  for (st in strata) {
    cat("\n\n#### ", st, " {.tabset}\n\n", sep = "")
    st_sub <- sub[sub$stratum_level == st, , drop = FALSE]
    ordered <- c(st_sub$label[st_sub$type == "pairwise"],
                 st_sub$label[st_sub$type == "one_vs_all"])
    for (comp in ordered) {
      cat("\n\n##### ", comp, "\n\n", sep = "")
      emit_multihit_contrast(comp, by_mh[[comp]], plots_mh[[comp]])
    }
  }
}
```
